purpose: Freeze deterministic T12-local state-transition semantics before the Godot runtime exists. This is a non-shipping oracle/model, not production gameplay code.
initialization: Validate the exact 100-level/10-milestone progression contract and binding index.
Restore a supplied valid T12-local snapshot or begin from the empty initial state.
Fresh Level 1 is intrinsically ready because it has no prerequisite or fact slot; it completes exactly once and produces its canonical intent/event.

authoritative_fact_observation.match_rule: Only RESOLVED binding rows matching source_task + fact_kind + source_id are eligible.
authoritative_fact_observation.fact_key_rule: For each newly satisfied binding row, combine its non-empty idempotency_domain with the producer idempotency_key to form the consumed T12 fact key.
authoritative_fact_observation.duplicate_rule: If all matching slots are already satisfied, or all corresponding domain/key identities were already consumed, observation is a deterministic no-op with no state growth.
authoritative_fact_observation.out_of_order_rule: Out-of-order valid authoritative facts are retained as satisfied T12 fact slots even when prerequisites are incomplete. The level stays locked and never skips prerequisites; the producer does not need to replay the retained fact.
authoritative_fact_observation.deferred_rule: DEFERRED_LATER_OWNER rows never match an observation and cannot satisfy a slot.
authoritative_fact_observation.invalid_rule: Unknown, ambiguous or malformed producer facts fail closed without mutation.

settlement.order: ascending numeric level order under deterministic fixed-point settlement
settlement.completion_rule: A non-complete level completes only when all prerequisite_level_ids are complete and all required_fact_ids are satisfied T12 fact slots.
settlement.cascade_rule: After each completion, continue scanning until no additional level can complete. Previously retained out-of-order slots may therefore complete after their prerequisites become complete.
settlement.event_rule: Record completion_event_id and milestone_ids in state before returning the intent.
settlement.replay_rule: Replay never re-emits a completed level, completion event, or milestone; completed levels and already-emitted IDs are deterministic no-ops.

progression_intent.unlocked_level_ids: direct dependents whose prerequisites are all complete after this completion; a listed dependent may remain fact-locked
progression_intent.source_fact_keys: domain-scoped fact keys recorded for the completed level's required fact slots; empty for Level 1

reject: completed fact-gated level without satisfied slot
emitted event/milestone not justified by completed state
consumed fact key not referenced by at least one satisfied fact-slot source-key mapping
emitted completion event not exactly justified by a completed level
snapshot_restore.recovery: A valid snapshot may contain satisfied slots whose levels are not yet complete because prerequisites were incomplete. Restore settles them deterministically if prerequisites are now complete, without re-emitting already-recorded IDs.
snapshot_restore.causality_rule: consumed_fact_keys equals the set of fact_slot_source_keys values; emitted completion events equal the canonical completion-event set implied by completed_level_ids; emitted milestones equal the milestone set implied by completed levels.

authority_boundaries: Never call T10 transform mutation APIs.
Never own T13 difficulty or T14 global save/version schema.
Reference model output cannot approve or activate T12.
